title: Fuzz Testing Introduction and Tools — libFuzzer/AFL++/boofuzz Harnesses
title_es: Introducción al Fuzz Testing y Herramientas — harnesses de libFuzzer/AFL++/boofuzz
description: Runnable companion for the Fuzz Testing Introduction and Tools guide: a self-contained C URL parser as fuzz target, a libFuzzer harness with seed corpus, an AFL++ 4.30c campaign script, and a boofuzz 0.4.2 HTTP request fuzzer.
description_es: Companion ejecutable de la guía de Fuzz Testing: un parser de URLs en C autocontenido como objetivo, un harness de libFuzzer con corpus semilla, un script de campaña para AFL++ 4.30c y un fuzzer de requests HTTP con boofuzz 0.4.2.
